title: What connectivity options does NovaTel offer for IoT/M2M devices?
content:
Question: What connectivity options does NovaTel offer for IoT/M2M devices?

Answer: NovaTel offers NB-IoT, LTE-M, and standard cellular M2M SIM profiles with volume-based data pooling, remote SIM management, and dedicated APNs for enterprise IoT deployments (fleet tracking, smart metering, POS terminals, etc.).

Topic: IoT & M2M Services
